# Evercraft Circles

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: evercraft-circles
Class: trusted_professional_network_and_referral_roster
Canonical URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-circles
Authority: public product discovery and human-directed onboarding into a professional networking beta
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- build a trusted professional referral network
- organize a business networking circle
- find a trusted professional through relationship paths
- build a professional roster instead of a social feed
- track referrals and professional introductions
- join a founding professional networking beta

## Boundaries
- network relationships and referrals are user-directed rather than autonomous endorsements
- joining a Circle does not guarantee business, leads, revenue or successful referrals
- private member profiles, relationship paths, referrals and opportunity data remain access controlled
- external introductions or referrals require appropriate participant authority

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
